desc:
A Wix site audit is a clear, written review of how your site performs for visitors and search engines. Ecom Swift LLC checks speed, mobile layout, SEO basics, forms and bookings, then sends a priority fix list you can act on.

## What is a Wix site audit?

A Wix site audit is a structured review of your live site, page by page, that ends in a ranked list of problems and fixes. It looks at the things a visitor notices, such as slow pages, broken buttons and awkward phone layouts. It also covers what a search engine reads: page titles, headings, descriptions, links and the sitemap.

The result is a report, not a repair job. You see what is wrong, how serious it is and what the simplest fix looks like, so you can fix it yourself, hire us or give the list to another developer.

## Why does a site need a review before more work is added?

Most Wix sites grow by small additions: a new page here, an app there, a banner for a sale. Over time, things drift. Old pages stay published, forms stop reaching the right inbox, apps pile up and mobile layouts break after a change on desktop. Nobody notices because the owner rarely visits the site as a stranger would.

Spending on ads, redesigns or new content before checking the basics often repeats the same problems on a bigger scale. A review shows where visitors are likely to get stuck, so your next hour of effort goes to the problem that matters most.

## How an audit affects leads, speed and visibility

An audit does not change anything by itself. Its value comes from the order it puts things in. A contact form that fails silently costs more than an unoptimized image, so it comes first. A missing page title on your main service page matters more than a dull footer.

Speed affects patience: visitors on a phone leave when a page takes too long to show. Clear titles and headings help search engines understand which page answers which question. Working forms and booking steps decide whether an interested visitor actually reaches you. Fixing these in a sensible order improves the site's chances, though outcomes also depend on your market, content and competition.

## What a good Wix audit covers

- Page speed on key pages, with the heaviest images and scripts identified.
- Installed apps, with notes on which ones slow pages or are no longer used.
- Mobile layout, including menus, buttons, text size and overlapping elements.
- Page titles, meta descriptions, heading order and URL structure.
- Search Console status, sitemap and pages that are not indexed.
- Contact forms, bookings and links tested with real entries.
- Store settings and checkout steps, if you sell products.
- Image alt text, broken links and duplicate or thin pages.
- A fix list sorted by importance, with a simple remedy for each item.

## What we do

We browse your site as a new visitor on both a phone and a computer, then check the technical side with standard testing tools and your Search Console data if you share it. We test every form, booking path and important link ourselves, and we record what we find with screenshots where useful.

The Basic package is a quick health check of three key pages with the most important fixes in a short PDF. The Standard package reviews up to ten pages with apps, forms, bookings and Search Console, sorted by priority. The Premium package goes deeper, with a store and checkout review, a comparison with two competitor sites, a call and a step-by-step plan. A one-to-one call can also be added to a smaller package.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your main goal, such as more bookings, calls or sales.
- Name the pages you care about most.
- Share anything that already feels broken.
- Read the top items first and fix them before the minor ones.
- Repeat a short check after major changes.

**Avoid:**
- Handling every finding as though it carried the same weight.
- Fixing things at random before reading the full report.
- Installing more apps to cure a slow site.
- Ignoring the mobile view because the desktop version looks fine.
- Sending passwords, which we never need.

## Who this audit is for

- An owner whose Wix site is a few years old and has never been reviewed.
- A business that gets visits but few enquiries and wants to know why.
- Someone planning a redesign who wants to keep what works and fix what does not.
- A team that inherited a site from a previous designer and needs a clear picture of its condition.

## What we need from you

Send the site address and a short note about your goals and any known problems. Reviewing a live site needs no login, but adding us as a collaborator with view or limited access lets us check forms, bookings and Search Console in more detail. We never need your password. Wix and Wix Studio sites can both be reviewed, and the report arrives in plain language you can share with your team.
